description:
From [**Occult Scans**](https://www.mangaupdates.com/group/zvq89ew/occult-scans)

Seunghyeon heads to Hong Kong chasing his dream of becoming a stunt actor, where he crosses paths with the young and highly successful director Yoo Cheonhwa.

However, because of their team leader’s meddling, Baek Seunghyeon ends up in Yoo Cheonhwa’s room and is drugged in an attempt to push the two into sleeping together. Because of that, Yoo Cheonhwa initially sees Seunghyeon as nothing more than a troublesome nuisance.

But as time passes, Yoo Cheonhwa begins to recognize Seunghyeon’s genuine personality and natural acting talent, and before long, he finds himself becoming increasingly drawn to him…
